Before you start

A parent or guardian is setting up FamilyGuard on this phone to help manage screen time and keep browsing safer.

While it is active, your guardian can see:
• Which apps you use and for how long
• Whether the phone is on or off and its battery level
• Your location, only if your guardian turns location sharing on

Your guardian can also:
• Set daily screen-time limits and bedtime
• Allow or block specific apps
• Turn on safer web browsing
• Lock the phone for a while (you can always make emergency calls)

FamilyGuard does NOT read your messages, listen to your calls, or record audio or video.

This app will always be visible and will always show a notification while it is active.
